note: Reputation (Dave 2026-10-21). Each NPC keeps a score for each player. A dialogue effect {"add_rep": n} adds points for THAT NPC (capped at max_points). Ranks come from the score: the highest rank whose `at` is not above it. Dialogue conditions: {"min_rep": points} or {"rank": "Friend"} (this rank or better) unlock choices and quests; a bark kind with the rank in lower case (greeting_friend) is preferred over the plain one; price_mult scales what an NPC charges (trainer lessons) by rank. Shown on the Tab character screen.
